 Chris Pratt Says Marvel Has Taken “Hard Action” To Bring Star-Lord Back: “He’s Not Going Anywhere” [Interview]
 By Rodrigo Perez and Christopher Marc 
 October 21, 2026 2:45 pm 
 0 
 222 
 Facebook X Pinterest WhatsApp 
 It’s been more than three years since Chris Pratt seemingly said goodbye to the Marvel Cinematic Universe in “ Guardians Of The Galaxy Vol. 3 .” Still, the film’s post-credits promise that “The Legendary Star-Lord Will Return” hasn’t materialized. With Marvel ’s upcoming “ Avengers” films bringing back seemingly everyone who’s ever worn a superhero costume , fans have naturally wondered whether Peter Quill might join the party.
 Well, according to Pratt, his return isn’t just wishful thinking. Speaking to The Playlist’s Mike DeAngelo on The Bingeworthy podcast while promoting “ The Terminal List ” Season 2, the actor revealed that Marvel has not only been discussing Star-Lord’s comeback but has already taken concrete steps to make it happen.
 This follows Pratt’s comments earlier this year about his Star-Lord pitch to Marvel , which he described as “f*cking great.”
 READ MORE: Michael Waldron Details Return For ‘Avengers: Doomsday,’ ‘Secret Wars,’ & Says ‘Nova’ Could Expand “The Cosmic Side Of The MCU” 
 “I have a great relationship with Kevin [Feige] and Lou [D’Esposito], and there have been both ongoing conversations about how we make good on that promise and also hard action taken to make sure that we make good on that promise,” he explained. “So yeah, you’ll see Star-Lord again, which is very exciting, but I’m not at liberty to say when that’s going to be, but he’s not going anywhere.”
 While Pratt is being tight-lipped about Peter Quill’s return despite the optimism, the Russo Brothers have been teasing that there are big surprises still in store for “ Avengers: Doomsday ,” and we cannot rule out that their Multiverse swan song, “ Avengers: Secret Wars ,” could be another path to have the charming cosmic hero return to the MCU fold, after returning to Earth to reconnect with his estranged grandfather played by Gregg Henry (shown at the end of “Guardians of the Galaxy Vol.3”). 
 Another factor here is that Marvel Studios and screenwriter Michael Waldron (“Loki”) are about to give fellow cosmic good guy Richard Rider a spotlight in the feature film “ Nova ,” and it could be a good way to bring Star-Lord/Guardians back after the James Gunn trilogy helped introduce the Nova Corps group (destroyed by Thanos off-screen on Xandar). And in the comics, it’s worth noting that John C. Reilly ‘s Rhomann Dey ends up linking up with Rider as a mentor of sorts and, in theory, could return as they try to rebuild that intergalactic police force (think the MCU’s version of “ Lanterns ” but could be mostly set off-world). That could be another gestating project that may allow Star-Lord to be called back to space.

 That said, Pratt returns for the second season of Prime Video ‘s “The Terminal List” and is set to debut today, October 21, on the streaming service. 
 Additional reporting by Mike DeAngelo.
